sections.content: megy ('to go') is one of Hungarian's irregular verbs and doesn't follow the normal -ek/-esz/-özik pattern. Its present tense forms need to be learned individually.

items.english: How are we going? (by what means)

sections.content: Notice how different megyünk (we go) looks from the infinitive menni -- this kind of stem change is common in Hungarian's small set of irregular verbs, so it's worth memorising megy as a whole table rather than trying to derive it from a rule.
